stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip '3-star' page, check-in 12 Nov 2026 (Thu), 1 night, 2 guests, pre-tax discounted price, all 16 listed (range 1,435-7,393). stay.notes: Kayak India 10-11 Oct listing prices (tax-incl 'from') agree: Hotel Le Roi 2,944, Yashail 3,190, Fortune Park 5,607, many budget rooms 677-1,450 (https://www.kayak.co.in/Haridwar-Hotels.44012.hotel.ksp). Cleartrip homestay page for Haridwar returned ordinary hotels, not homestays, so no homestay median. Hostelworld shows 'No Dorms Available' for Haridwar (4 private-room listings only).

point_to_point.route: Haridwar to Dehradun airport Jolly Grant (~35 km)

taxi_day.basis: Median of 4 sedan 8h/80km quotes: Rajputana Cabs 1,600 (page published 2026-07-02), Evaara guide 1,600-1,900 (mid 1,750, article 8 Aug 2026), CabBazar 2,014 and Bizar Expedition 3,600 (both from search-result snippets; both sites not fetchable by me). Range 1,600-3,600, so operators differ 2x. Per km 11-13 sedan (Evaara). Not a union card: Haridwar has no published union list that I found.
taxi_day.notes: Most visitors use autos/e-rickshaws inside town: Evaara says short hops are typically 50-150. Station to Har Ki Pauri (~4 km) sedan 150-250. Peak (Kanwar, Kumbh, Char Dham) adds 30-50% per Evaara.

food_per_person_day.basis: Budget = 3 meals at street/dhaba level: poori plate 80-100 (Mohan Ji, Tripadvisor reviews), kachori/chole bhature 50-150, unlimited thali 150 (Wanderlog review), Bengali thali 80; ~115 per meal median x3. Standard = 3 x median per-meal at sit-down places: Hoshiyarpuri 250 (TripXL avg cost) / 125 (Zomato 250 for two), Chotiwala 325 (TripXL) / 300 (Zomato 600 for two), Sindhi Dhaba 200, Mathura Wale 150 (Zomato 300 for two) -> median 250 -> 750.
food_per_person_day.notes: TripXL page dated 2 Jan 2025 and does not say whether 'average cost' is per person (assumed). Zomato cost-for-two figures are from search-result snippets (Zomato page timed out for me) and may be old. Haridwar is mostly pure-veg; no alcohol.

unverified: Homestay median (no true homestay list found)
Union/official taxi rate card (only private operator quotes)

point_to_point.route: Rishikesh to Neelkanth Mahadev round trip (32 km each way)

taxi_day.basis: Median of 3 sedan 8h/80km quotes: CabBazar 1,700 (search snippet), Ganpati Tours/GT Cabs 'from 2,000' (search snippet), Triveni Cabs 2,499 incl fuel/driver/AC (page last updated 14 Sep 2026, fetched; its fare-guide page says 2,000-2,500). Extra km 14, extra hour 200 (Triveni). Range 1,700-2,499.
taxi_day.notes: Laxman/Ram Jhula area is walkable; cab drops and waits. Neelkanth + Kunjapuri + Jhulas in one day can exceed 80 km (extra km 14). Neelkanth round-trip figure is from search-result snippets of two operators and was not independently fetched.

food_per_person_day.basis: Budget: puri-sabzi 60, chole kulche 40, rajma/kadhi chawal half plate 40, masala dosa 80-150, aloo tikki chaat 30, lassi 40-80 (swaadyatra, updated 8 May 2026); ~3 x 100-120. Standard = 3 x median per-meal at cafes: Freedom Cafe 200-400, Little Buddha 200-400, Tattva 200-500, The 60s Cafe 300-600, Ganga View Cafe 200-350 (per-person ranges, mid-points 300/300/350/450/275) and Chotiwala thali 400-450 shared by two (~212 each) -> median 300 -> 900.
food_per_person_day.notes: Pure-veg, alcohol-free town so the no-alcohol assumption holds. Cafe per-person ranges are the page's own, not cost-for-two. Sitting Elephant Cafe 500-1,000 pp excluded as outlier.

unverified: Dated menu photos for cafes (relied on one aggregator page dated May 2026)

stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip '3-star' page, 12-13 Nov 2026 (Thu), pre-tax discounted; 18 listed, dropped 2 hostels (Zostel, Hosteller) and 2 four-star resorts (Yog Wellness, Club Mahindra) -> 14 (range 670-7,388). Budget: Cleartrip budget page, Sun 11 Oct-Mon 12 Oct (year not printed), pre-tax, 20 listed (range 605-1,960). Homestay: Cleartrip homestay page 12-13 Nov 2026, dropped 3 luxury villas (16,600-17,988) and 5 ordinary hotels -> 7 (range 1,540-6,290); with the villas the median would be 3,629. Dorm: Hostelworld 'Dorms From' (no dates shown), 7 hostels, range 488-824.
stay.notes: Kayak 10-11 Oct (tax-incl 'from') corroborates: cheap hotels 1,353-2,417, Hotel Hamers International 2,420, Social Stays 2,225 (https://www.kayak.co.in/Mussoorie-Hotels.46381.hotel.ksp). Mussoorie Heights (670) sits on the 3-star page but is clearly budget; it was kept to avoid cherry-picking. November is not peak: May-June and Dec are dearer (Kayak monthly averages are dominated by luxury hotels and not usable).

taxi_day.basis: Median of 3 private-operator sedan full-day Mussoorie sightseeing packages (Mall Rd, Gun Hill, Company Garden, Lal Tibba, Kempty Falls): taxiservicemussoorie.in 2,600 (full day 8-10h, 'indicative from'), Maharana Cabs 2,600, Bharat Taxi 3,150 (Dzire, 8h/80km, 13-14/km). Excluded dooncabs.com 3,500 because the page's only date is a 2015 footer. Range 2,600-3,500. The union (Mussoorie Taxi Service Association, Library 0135-2630587) posts a board rate but its site had a certificate error and I did not bypass it, so the actual union rate card is unverified. Old Tripadvisor reviewer said union charged 3,000/day (approx 7 years old, search-result snippet).
taxi_day.notes: None of these are dated on the page. Tolls, parking, entry tickets extra. Peak May-June and Dec. Mall Road/Company Garden are walkable. Day-tour combining Dhanaulti is 3,800 (taxiservicemussoorie.in) to 4,500 (dooncabs, stale).

food_per_person_day.basis: Cost-for-two for 20 Mussoorie/Landour cafes and eateries (The Hosteller blog 25 Jul 2024: 10 places 400-1,700; FoodRavel 2026 undated: 10 places, mid-points 300-800). Pooled median 600 for two = 300 per meal -> standard 3 x 300 = 900. Budget = 3 x 200 (cheapest tier: Kalsang 400 for two, Char Dukan 400-600, Cafe by the Way 400).
food_per_person_day.notes: The sample is cafe-heavy (tourist cafes), so true dhaba-level eating (momos, parathas, thali) will be cheaper than the 'budget' figure; I found no dated dhaba thali price for Mussoorie. Cafe Ivy is an outlier (600-1,700 for two).

unverified: Union taxi rate card (site cert error, not bypassed)

stay.nearest_base: Mussoorie (Landour is a ridge neighbourhood of Mussoorie; most rooms are in guesthouses and cottages)
stay.price_basis: Homestay: TravelTriangle list of 15 Landour homestays, page updated 5 Dec 2024, per-night prices as printed (taxes unstated); excluded one priced per person. Range 650-7,000. These are 2024 prices, so likely 5-15% stale.
stay.notes: Landour has no OTA city list I could read (Cleartrip has no Landour page). Undated or stale singles only: Hotelsmussoorie.com (copyright 2017-18) Tabor Cottage 1,800, Ivy Bank Guest House 2,500, Golden Heaven 1,600, Adventure Tour Resort 890; Kayak 10-11 Oct Rokeby Manor 24,463 (heritage luxury). No mid/budget median reported because the dated sample is too thin; use Mussoorie's figures for the town hotels.

taxi_day.basis: Proxy only: Landour has no taxi stand or rate card of its own. The Mussoorie full-day sedan package (median of 3 operators, see mussoorie) includes Lal Tibba/Landour; Maharana Cabs and dooncabs list Lal Tibba in the full-day itinerary. Landour itself (Char Dukan, Lal Tibba, Mall to Clock Tower) is walkable and most visitors walk.
taxi_day.notes: A search-result summary said a taxi to Landour Clock Tower costs 500-600, but it did not name the page, so I did not use it.

food_per_person_day.basis: Landour cafes only, cost for two: Landour Bakehouse 500-800, Cafe de Landour 500-700, Lotte's 300-500, Cafe de Tavern 500-700, Anil's Char Dukan 400-600, Chic Chocolate 500-800, Mudcup 600-800, Little Llama 400-1,000, Cafe Ivy 600-1,700 (FoodRavel and The Hosteller). Median about 600 for two = 300 per meal -> 3 x 300 = 900; budget uses the cheapest tier (~400 for two) -> 3 x 200 = 600.
food_per_person_day.notes: Almost all Landour eating is cafes; there are few dhabas, so 'budget' is a Char Dukan/Lotte's-level figure.

unverified: Mid-range and budget hotel medians (no readable dated list for Landour)

stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip '3-star' page, 12-13 Nov 2026 (Thu), pre-tax discounted, 15 listed (range 1,154-7,610; one Kanatal property, Aurevelle Kastura, dropped). Budget: single property Silver Dew Resorts on the Mussoorie-Chamba highway, Sun 11 Oct-Mon 12 Oct, pre-tax 1,456 (n=1 only).
stay.notes: Cleartrip's Dhanaulti page covers the whole Dhanaulti-Kanatal-Chamba belt (e.g. Hotel Alpine Musk is shown under Kanatal by Kayak). The lowest 5 of the 15 (LaCliff 1,154, Glamwood 1,620, Mount View 1,792, The Bliss 1,812, Rock Resort 1,882) are the realistic budget tier but are not labelled budget, so I did not split them out. Budget n=1 is not a median.

taxi_day.basis: Proxy: Dhanaulti has almost no resident taxi fleet; visitors take the Mussoorie + Dhanaulti day tour. taxiservicemussoorie.in lists 'Mussoorie and Dhanaulti from 3,800' (sedan 4,500 at dooncabs.com, undated). Trekgo (23 Aug 2026) gives 3,500-4,200 per day for a multi-day Dehradun rental covering Dhanaulti, Surkanda Devi and Kanatal. Public alternative: GMOU bus Mussoorie-Dhanaulti 60-80, UTC bus Dehradun-Dhanaulti 120-150.
taxi_day.notes: No Dhanaulti-specific local day rate was found; the 3,800 is the cheapest observed sedan day that includes Dhanaulti and is based in Mussoorie.

food_per_person_day.basis: Budget only: Unpaqd (20 Jan 2026, Kanatal/Dhanaulti belt) says dhaba meals 100-150 and homestay home-cooked meals 150-200 extra per meal; 3 meals at about 125-175 each ~ 450. Holidify lists Glass House (Apple Orchard Resort) at INR 300 and Little Llama Cafe 100-400 but states no price basis, so no standard figure was derived.
food_per_person_day.notes: Restaurant Guru and Tripadvisor pages show only price symbols for Dhanaulti. Many hotels sell meal plans. Mussoorie's standard (900) is the nearest observed analogue but is not used here.

Kayak snippet also lists Kanasar Home Stay from 1,250 (n=1, no homestay median). A third-party travel blog says GMVN Hanol Tourist Bungalow AC rooms from about 1,000 (official gmvnonline.com tariff page returned 403 and was not bypassed). Tripoto trip report (undated) said rooms 700-2,000.

taxi_day.basis: Mid-point of a Tripoto traveller report: 'taxi will cost you 2500-3000 private for nearby points like Deoban, Lakhamandal, Tiger Falls' (undated trip report). Standard not derived: Holidify shows Kanatal Resort and Spa 800 and Camp Wildex 400 but gives no price basis; Tripadvisor shows only symbols.

stay.nearest_base: Ramnagar / Dhikuli / Garjia (no lodging inside the park; core-zone permits needed)
stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip Ramnagar '3-star' page, 12-13 Nov 2026 (Thu), pre-tax, 16 listed, dropped 4 luxury (Rattan Elwood 24,750, Forest Roar 26,150, Cotton Tree 26,150, Earavat by Aamod 11,160) -> 12 (range 1,689-6,714). Budget: Cleartrip Sun 11 Oct-Mon 12 Oct pre-tax: Carnival 999, Motel Resort 1,568, Deer View 1,792, Safari Park 1,907, Karan's 1,922.
stay.notes: Timing caveat: both captures are BEFORE the core zones reopen on 15 Nov, i.e. off-season/shoulder prices. Peak season (roughly Nov-June, weekends, holidays) is higher. The homestays-in-ramnagar page returned resorts (Sterling Riverview 13,500, Club Mahindra Patkote 11,544 etc.), not homestays. Echo Home Stay 5,312 is the only homestay-labelled row seen (n=1).

taxi_day.basis: Median of 3 sedan quotes: Singh Tour & Travel 1,800-2,000 for 8h/80km (page 31 May 2025), Corbett Online 'local tour/day' 3,000 (page footer 2026; includes 6-point sightseeing), Guru Kripa Taxi 3,200 per day for 125 km (undated, extra 14/km). Range 1,900-3,200; the 3,000+ quotes cover more km/fixed itineraries.
taxi_day.notes: Safari is a separate cost: a private-agency article (corbettonlinebooking.com, Feb 2026) lists gypsy jeep for Indians per vehicle (up to 6) Jhirna/Dhela 6,500-7,200, Bijrani/Durgadevi 7,500-8,500, Sitabani 5,200-6,200, guide included, Dhikala not a day safari. Those are agency prices, not the Forest Department portal, so verify before publishing.

food_per_person_day.basis: Justdial cost-for-two for 7 Ramnagar eateries (search-result snippet): Kundan 400, New Shere Punjab 500, Shan A Punjab 700, Copper 700, Corbett Hill Queen 750, High Speed Life 750, The Grill Kabab Treat 750; median 700 for two = 350 per meal -> standard 3 x 350 = 1,050. Budget = 3 x 225 from the cheapest two (400, 500). Doabas Punjabi Dhaba 1,200-1,600 for two excluded as a tourist-stop outlier.
food_per_person_day.notes: Justdial pages were not fetched (blocked or snippet only). Most Corbett visitors eat in resort meal plans (price not in this research). Includes non-veg and veg places; no alcohol assumed.
